## [3.71.5] - 2026-09-01

### Bug Fixes

- refresh product details after edits
- update edited products by primary key
- omit image URL from product editor
- restore main product image URL edit
- omit invalid language on barcode updates
- keep simple product barcode editing
- refresh variants without template ids
- limit variant edits to barcode
- refresh localized product names after edits
- edit variants from product details
- hide order sync diagnostics from cashier screens
- omit unchanged variant extra price writes
- handle variant extras in product edit refresh
- refresh variant state after product edits
- scope POS product updates

### Other Changes

- Revert "chore(windows): allow explicit multi-instance QA runs"
- allow explicit multi-instance QA runs
- Preserve remote order line descriptions
